name: Transformer high-voltage bushing reference
summary: Identifies the insulated conductor passage between the transformer winding system and its external terminal.
description: Identifies the insulated conductor passage between the transformer winding system and its external terminal. High-voltage primary equipment carries, interrupts, measures or conditions the main power circuit. Its function, insulation arrangement and equipment boundaries need to be distinguished from the secondary signals used to control it.

In a switchyard equipment diagram, the primary reference identifies the electrical role of an installed component while the linked equipment schedule and manufacturer drawing supply its exact construction and dimensions. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Transformer winding connection” at the input and “External high-voltage terminal” at the output. A bushing is not a separate switching device.
